findings.claim: AXT 所有基板與原料產品皆由中國子公司與合資企業在中國製造，亞洲總部在北京，三處廠區均在中國
findings.excerpt: All of its substrate products and raw material products are manufactured in the PRC by its PRC subsidiaries and joint ventures.

findings.claim: 中國自 2025-02-04 將 InP 基板納入出口管制；2026 年 6 月 10-Q 稱尚無輸美 GaAs 出口許可獲批，輸美 InP 許可於春季募股說明書時仍在最後審查
findings.excerpt: As of the spring 2026 prospectus, U.S.-bound InP permits were in the final stages of review but had not yet been issued.

findings.claim: 出口許可時程不在 AXT 控制範圍，造成階段性供給衝擊；InP 首張許可 2025 年 6 月底取得
findings.source: Capital Blueprint Substack, AXT Deep Analysis Report
findings.excerpt: This creates episodic supply shocks even when demand is robust.

findings.claim: AXT 垂直整合：持有中國原料合資股權，並開始精煉高純銦（緩解原料面風險）
findings.source: Capital Blueprint Substack via search summary
findings.excerpt: The company recently began refining high-purity indium, giving it greater control over a particularly important input for InP production.
